site.name: FeelFrame™
site.tagline: Some feelings deserve to be seen.
site.description: Visual stories built around real emotions, milestones and human moments.

stories.moment: Turning an ordinary personal photograph into a high-impact campaign visual.
stories.title: Your photo. Now it breaks the frame.
stories.quote: Your ordinary photograph can become something people stop to look at.
stories.context: A personal portrait is transformed into a cinematic 3D advertising composition where the subject appears to break through a digital frame surrounded by torn-paper layers, depth, perspective, lighting, and social-media interface elements.
stories.description: A cinematic 3D visual concept designed to turn an ordinary personal photograph into a high-impact campaign composition. The visual combines depth, perspective, identity, editorial lighting and physical-looking paper construction to create a result that feels deliberately designed rather than simply filtered.
stories.recipe: Personal portrait + 3D depth + torn-paper construction + digital interface + cinematic advertising composition

stories.moment: Reimagining an existing portrait as a complete visual campaign around your identity.
stories.title: Your photo. Reimagined as a campaign.
stories.quote: Your profile can become more than a profile.
stories.context: An ordinary portrait becomes a cinematic 3D advertising composition where the subject breaks beyond a digital interface, surrounded by controlled lighting, depth, luxury visual language, branding, and editorial art direction.
stories.description: A premium AI visual creation concept for turning an ordinary personal photo into cinematic 3D advertising artwork. The visual is built around identity, depth, contrast, personalized branding and editorial art direction rather than a conventional AI filter.
stories.recipe: Personal portrait + digital interface + 3D depth + personalized branding + luxury editorial campaign

stories.moment: Seeing yourself transformed into both the creator and the collectible.
stories.title: What if you could see yourself twice?
stories.quote: Once as the creator. Once as the collectible.
stories.context: A full-size version of the subject stands inside a modern creative studio beside a hyper-realistic 1/7-scale miniature version of themselves, creating a surreal relationship between person and collectible.
stories.description: A luxury miniature studio concept that transforms a single portrait into a scene featuring both the real subject and a hyper-realistic collectible version of themselves. The visual uses scale, material realism, studio lighting and physical interaction to create a surprising personal-branding image.
stories.recipe: Full-size portrait + 1/7-scale miniature identity + creative studio + realistic materials + controlled commercial lighting

stories.moment: Turning a digital profile into a physical visual object.
stories.title: What if your profile could exist in your hand?
stories.context: A portrait and digital profile are transformed into a transparent glass identity card held in a human hand, combining the subject's face, name, handle, profile information, interface elements, reflections, and futuristic materials.
stories.description: A futuristic editorial concept that turns a digital profile into a tangible 3D glass identity object. The composition combines personal profile information, realistic glass properties, hand interaction, cinematic lighting and premium interface design.
stories.recipe: Portrait + glass identity card + profile interface + hand interaction + refraction + futuristic editorial lighting

stories.moment: Breaking beyond the limitations of an ordinary profile photograph.
stories.title: What if your profile broke out of the screen?
stories.quote: You were never meant to stay inside the frame.
stories.context: An ordinary portrait becomes a cinematic 3D social-media composition where the subject appears to physically cross beyond the boundaries of the digital profile frame.
stories.description: A cinematic 3D social-media visual that makes the subject appear to step beyond the boundaries of an ordinary profile photograph. The concept combines depth, perspective, interface design, lighting and realistic identity preservation.
stories.recipe: Profile portrait + digital frame + subject breakout + dimensional depth + cinematic studio lighting

stories.moment: Seeing an ordinary photograph as the beginning of an entirely different visual world.
stories.title: Your photo is the beginning. Give it a world.
stories.quote: The photograph is only where the story begins.
stories.context: A familiar photograph is transformed into a cinematic 3D visual concept using scale, perspective, fashion, architecture, lighting, depth, and atmosphere to create a new visual story around the subject.
stories.description: A reusable cinematic 3D visual concept for transforming an ordinary photograph into an entirely different visual world. The concept can adapt to personal branding, graduation, creator content, fashion, social campaigns and personal experiments while keeping identity recognizable.
stories.recipe: Reference portrait + scale + perspective + architecture + fashion + cinematic lighting + environmental storytelling

stories.moment: Visualizing the artist identity and world you're building before the release arrives.
stories.title: Your photo is the beginning. Give it a world.
stories.quote: Build the world before the release arrives.
stories.context: A portrait becomes a cinematic music-artist campaign inside a luxury vehicle, surrounded by immersive music interfaces, futuristic lighting, reflections, editorial styling, and personalized artist information.
stories.description: A cinematic music-artist campaign concept designed to turn an existing portrait into a complete visual world. The scene places the subject inside a luxury environment surrounded by music interfaces, futuristic light, editorial styling and personalized artist information.
stories.recipe: Artist portrait + luxury vehicle + music interface + cinematic city light + futuristic editorial direction

stories.moment: Exploring two versions of the same identity inside one impossible visual world.
stories.title: What if one photo could show two versions of you?
stories.quote: One identity. Two versions. One visual world.
stories.context: A single reference portrait is transformed into a cinematic editorial composition featuring two versions of the same person interacting across physical and digital spaces.
stories.description: A cinematic dual-identity editorial concept exploring transformation through two versions of the same subject. The composition combines physical and digital spaces, luxury textures, urban architecture and fashion-editorial direction while keeping the identity recognizable.
stories.recipe: Reference portrait + dual identity + physical/digital interaction + urban architecture + luxury editorial composition

stories.moment: Exploring the relationship between individual identity and the people or society surrounding it.
stories.title: What if your portrait was made of people?
stories.quote: An individual can still belong to something larger.
stories.context: A familiar portrait is reconstructed as a three-dimensional crowd composition made from thousands of individually positioned human figures, allowing the recognizable portrait to emerge from the collective.
stories.description: A conceptual visual about identity, belonging and society. From a distance, the viewer sees a recognizable portrait; up close, the portrait reveals itself as a collective of individually positioned human figures.
stories.recipe: Portrait silhouette + human crowd + gallery environment + natural daylight + collective identity concept

stories.moment: Seeing one identity through two different artistic interpretations.
stories.title: What if your portrait could exist in two worlds?
stories.quote: One side photographed. The other interpreted.
stories.context: A realistic photographic portrait and a monochrome charcoal interpretation of the same identity occupy one fine-art editorial composition.
stories.description: A fine-art editorial concept that places a realistic portrait and a monochrome charcoal interpretation of the same identity into one composition. The visual explores contrast between photography and illustration, precision and texture, and reality and interpretation.
stories.recipe: Portrait + charcoal interpretation + monochrome contrast + negative space + fine-art editorial composition

stories.moment: Turning an ordinary portrait into a cinematic moment that feels like part of a larger story.
stories.title: What if your photo looked like a scene from a film?
stories.quote: Some moments feel like they belong in a larger story.
stories.context: A familiar portrait is reimagined as an atmospheric cinematic editorial scene with warm directional light, shallow depth of field, film-inspired texture, soft background separation, and a deliberate sense of narrative.
stories.description: A cinematic editorial concept designed to make an ordinary portrait feel like a scene from a larger film. Warm directional light, shallow depth of field, film-inspired texture and atmospheric separation create a deliberate sense of story.
stories.recipe: Portrait + warm directional light + shallow depth + film texture + atmospheric editorial storytelling

stories.moment: Reimagining an everyday photograph with the visual language of a fashion campaign.
stories.title: What if your camera roll had a cover in it?
stories.quote: An everyday photograph can carry a campaign.
stories.context: An ordinary portrait is transformed into a refined luxury fashion-editorial concept using intentional wardrobe, controlled studio lighting, natural skin texture, clean composition, and cinematic depth.
stories.description: A refined luxury editorial concept that reimagines an everyday photograph using the visual language of a fashion campaign. The focus is on intentional presentation, natural skin texture, controlled lighting, clean composition and quiet luxury.
stories.recipe: Everyday portrait + fashion direction + clean tailoring + controlled studio lighting + quiet luxury composition
